Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You whisper into your cupped hand and cast the sound toward the empty stairwell. Your words emerge from the place you point to.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Guile
Target / range / shape
An audible point within 4 squares
Duration
One brief sound or short phrase, then the effect ends.
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Magic / Utility

Lasts only long enough to deliver the sound. No mind control or automatic deception. The listener responds to the fiction; DA calls further rolls only when consequences require them.

Weak
Create a brief nonverbal sound.
Standard
Create one short phrase in your own voice.
Strong
Create one short phrase in a voice you have heard.
